title: Saudi Curry Fish Fry
description: A flavorful fish fry dish with a unique twist from Saudi Arabian cuisine. The velvety curry sauce complements the fish perfectly.

ingredients.name: Saudi curry powder
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern stores

instructions: 1. Marinate the fish fillets in a mixture of lemon juice, salt, and black pepper for 30 minutes.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the fish fillets to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
4. In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
5. Add the velvety curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
6. Add the Saudi curry powder and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
7. Add the cooked fish fillets to the curry sauce and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
8. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
